Name: Traveling Merchant Buys Any Item
Author: JohnG3
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
With this mod, you will be able to sell absolutely any item from your inventory to the traveling merchant at each item's standard price.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
After downloading the file ([MOD_SHOP_TRAVELER] TravelingMerchantBuysAnyItem.rar), extract it into the Mods folder of your Stardew Valley game.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
For the mod to work, you need to have the game updated to version 1.6 or later and have SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) installed.
SMAPI link: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Thanks to everyone who downloads this mod. Please rate it positively if you like it!
